ticket.title: Retire the ten legacy .storypole/ledger.jsonl files left behind by the CO-7 unification
ticket.description:
ALREADY DONE, verified 2026-11-10: no .storypole directory and no ledger.jsonl exists at any depth under the suite (find over all twelve repositories, excluding .git). The ten legacy ledgers were retired by the CO-7 unification and the records migration, and nothing references them.

RE-CHECKED 2026-11-12 AND DELIBERATELY NOT CLOSED, because the claim as written is broader than its title. The title target is gone: no .storypole directory exists anywhere in the suite. But the description says no ledger.jsonl exists at any depth, and one does: common/.gaugeblock/storypole/ledger.jsonl, in a store whose tickets/ directory makes Records authoritative - so it is a dead file beside a live store rather than a live ledger, and the difference matters to whoever reads this ticket next. Narrow the ticket to retiring that leftover (or confirm migrate should archive it), rather than closing on a sentence that is not true.
acceptance_criteria: DONE 2026-11-06. Executed the archive: each of the ten legacy .storypole/ledger.jsonl files copied to .gaugeblock/storypole/ledger-archive/<repo>.jsonl in the meta-harness root
line count verified against the source before removal
then git rm'd in its own repo with its own commit. Verified after: zero legacy ledgers anywhere (find returns 0)

archive holds 10 files / 128 events total - exactly the 128 member events the audit counted - and all 10 .storypole/plans/*.md design documents survived untouched (law 11). Every repo clean. SP-4 was already recovered separately and is in the backlog as P2 Bug.
